side-roads.name: Side roads
side-roads.blurb: An exit lane beside the right-hand lane: a way round the jam.

crossroads.name: Crossroads
crossroads.blurb: The road turns, or runs straight through, a crossroads.

lanes-closing.name: Lanes closing
lanes-closing.blurb: The outer lanes close and everyone squeezes in.

bridges.name: Bridges
bridges.blurb: No shoulder on a bridge: steel stands beside the outer lanes.

ice.name: Ice
ice.blurb: Brakes and steering lose most of their grip, and the car slews.

mud.name: Mud
mud.blurb: Mud slows the car, a nimble sports car worst of all.

the-tide.name: The tide
the-tide.blurb: The sea floods your side of the road, wave by wave.

the-bullet-train.name: The bullet train
the-bullet-train.blurb: A railway down the middle of the road slows any car crossing it.

the-giant-frog.name: The giant frog
the-giant-frog.blurb: A huge frog hops about a stretch of road. You hear it croak first.

cows.name: Cows
cows.blurb: A herd wanders back and forth across the road.

kangaroos.name: Kangaroos
kangaroos.blurb: Kangaroos bound across the road, with a sign before their stretch.

drop-bears.name: Drop bears
drop-bears.blurb: They wait in the gum trees and drop as you come near.

the-great-migration.name: The great migration
the-great-migration.blurb: A great herd streams across the road, all one way.

elephants.name: Elephants
elephants.blurb: Elephants plod across the road and back, resting at each side.

hippos.name: Hippos
hippos.blurb: A hippo charges across the road at where you'll be.

the-storm.name: The storm
the-storm.blurb: A hurricane hurls cars through the air above the road.

asteroid-fields.name: Asteroid fields
asteroid-fields.blurb: Rocks scattered over space: some at road level, some off it.

dancing-portaloos.name: Dancing portaloos
dancing-portaloos.blurb: Rows of portaloos across the road, dancing in step.

construction-machinery.name: Construction machinery
construction-machinery.blurb: Bulldozers and diggers trundle across the road and back.

trenches.name: Trenches
trenches.blurb: The shoulder is dug up, with steel plates laid across it.

site-works.name: Site works
site-works.blurb: Excavator buckets swing over the road; barrows and pipes cross it.

falling-wreckage.name: Falling wreckage
falling-wreckage.blurb: Scripted destruction beside the road as you come near.

quarries.name: Quarries
quarries.blurb: A quarry cut into the hillside beside the road.

blasts.name: Blasts
blasts.blurb: A building or quarry face blows out across the road.

boulders.name: Boulders
boulders.blurb: Boulders come down off the rock face onto the road.

the-control-tower.name: The control tower
the-control-tower.blurb: The control tower comes crashing down across the old road.

gang-houses.name: Gang houses
gang-houses.blurb: Gang houses marked out for all to see, windows glowing red.

drive-bys.name: Drive-bys
drive-bys.blurb: A low sedan that pulls up beside a target and opens fire.

punctures.name: Punctures
punctures.blurb: A shot, pothole or trench gap can puncture a tyre.

police-stretches.name: Police stretches
police-stretches.blurb: Police only in some stretches: heavy there, none elsewhere.

races.name: Races
races.blurb: Laps of a real circuit against a full grid.

rival-couriers.name: Rival couriers
rival-couriers.blurb: Other couriers racing you to the drop, each marked by an arrow.

emergency-vehicles.name: Emergency vehicles
emergency-vehicles.blurb: Now and then an ambulance comes through, siren going.

police-pursuit.name: Police pursuit
police-pursuit.blurb: A getaway car flat out, an interceptor close behind.

wrong-way-drivers.name: Wrong-way drivers
wrong-way-drivers.blurb: A car carries straight on from a side road, coming at you.

traffic-with-quirks.name: Traffic with quirks
traffic-with-quirks.blurb: The ice cream van potters, the bin lorry pulls up, hazards on.

tractors.name: Tractors
tractors.blurb: Slow farm traffic that waits until you come near.

the-ufo.name: The UFO
the-ufo.blurb: You fly a flying saucer instead of your car.

water-stages.name: Water stages
water-stages.blurb: A slipway into a channel of water: only amphibious cars float.

boats.name: Boats
boats.blurb: The traffic of a water stage: dinghies, ferries, barges, pedalos.

the-jetboat.name: The jetboat
the-jetboat.blurb: You drive a jetboat across open water, past breakwaters.

two-armies.name: Two armies
two-armies.blurb: Lanes run both ways: your green army, and the red enemy at you.

your-8x8.name: Your 8x8
your-8x8.blurb: You drive an 8x8, always in the green army.

landmines.name: Landmines
landmines.blurb: Mines lie buried until you are close, then pop up, light flashing.

pillboxes.name: Pillboxes
pillboxes.blurb: Pillboxes beside the road fire at the other army as it passes.

speed-cameras.name: Speed cameras
speed-cameras.blurb: A camera behind a limit sign: go over it and the screen flashes.

funeral-processions.name: Funeral processions
funeral-processions.blurb: A hearse and cars in black, nose to tail in one lane.

level-crossings.name: Level crossings
level-crossings.blurb: Lights, bell and booms, then a train shoots across the road.

stop-go-roadworks.name: Stop / go roadworks
stop-go-roadworks.blurb: The oncoming side is dug up: both ways take turns in one lane.

fog-banks.name: Fog banks
fog-banks.blurb: The fog closes right in: you see only a short way ahead.

potholes.name: Potholes
potholes.blurb: Ragged holes in the lanes: a jolt, and some speed lost.

rockfall.name: Rockfall
rockfall.blurb: Rocks tumble off the hillside onto the road as you come near.

cyclist-pelotons.name: Cyclist pelotons
cyclist-pelotons.blurb: A bunch of cyclists, two abreast by the kerb.

school-crossings.name: School crossings
school-crossings.blurb: The lollipop person's sign turns to STOP and the children cross.

burst-water-mains.name: Burst water mains
burst-water-mains.blurb: A burst main sprays one lane, on and off.

hot-air-balloons.name: Hot-air balloons
hot-air-balloons.blurb: A balloon comes down onto the road, sits, then lifts away.

drawbridges.name: Drawbridges
drawbridges.blurb: Bells and booms, then the bridge lifts open. Traffic waits.

wide-loads.name: Wide loads
wide-loads.blurb: Half a house on a low loader, two lanes wide, with an escort.

shopping-trolleys.name: Shopping trolleys
shopping-trolleys.blurb: Escaped trolleys roll across the road with its camber.

marathons.name: Marathons
marathons.blurb: Runners two abreast, a pace car ahead, a water station beyond.

stampedes.name: Stampedes
stampedes.blurb: Cows or kangaroos charge down the road at you, weaving.

road-train-jackknife.name: Road-train jackknife
road-train-jackknife.blurb: A road train locks its brakes and its trailers swing across.

tunnels.name: Tunnels
tunnels.blurb: No sky, the dark closing in, and only lamps and headlights.

parades.name: Parades
parades.blurb: Floats abreast in every lane, a marching band behind them.

police-roadblocks.name: Police roadblocks
police-roadblocks.blurb: Police cars across every lane but one: find the gap.

falling-cargo.name: Falling cargo
falling-cargo.blurb: A cargo truck sheds crates and bales onto the road.

ice-cream-stops.name: Ice-cream stops
ice-cream-stops.blurb: An ice-cream van stopped in a lane, jingle going, queue behind.

reversible-lanes.name: Reversible lanes
reversible-lanes.blurb: A lane under overhead signs that turns oncoming as you near.

convoys.name: Convoys
convoys.blurb: A convoy of vehicles nose to tail in one lane, moving as one.

rubbernecking.name: Rubbernecking
rubbernecking.blurb: After a wreck the traffic slows to look: the jam follows.

crosswinds.name: Crosswinds
crosswinds.blurb: A steady push to one side, and a gust every few seconds.

ramp-over-the-jam.name: Ramp over the jam
ramp-over-the-jam.blurb: A car transporter's ramps at the back of a jam: jump the queue.

washboard-dirt.name: Washboard dirt
washboard-dirt.blurb: A worn, corrugated road: the wheels hop at any speed.

low-bridge.name: Low bridge
low-bridge.blurb: A height bar across your side, with an exit before it.

ford.name: Ford
ford.blurb: The road runs straight through a river; the bridge is the exit.

speed-cushions.name: Speed cushions
speed-cushions.blurb: A row of speed cushions: the gaps are on the lane lines.

black-ice-in-the-shade.name: Black ice in the shade
black-ice-in-the-shade.blurb: Black ice lies in the shadow of tall trees. You can see the shadow.

ruts.name: Ruts
ruts.blurb: Deep mud with a rut down each lane that holds the car firm.

fresh-tarmac.name: Fresh tarmac
fresh-tarmac.blurb: One lane of new tar, coned off and empty; the traffic crawls past.

truck-spray.name: Truck spray
truck-spray.blurb: Vans, buses and lorries drag a long cloud of spray on a wet road.

low-sun.name: Low sun
low-sun.blurb: A stretch straight into a low sun that washes out the picture.

dust-trail.name: Dust trail
dust-trail.blurb: Everything on a dry dirt road throws a plume of dust.

flooded-underpass.name: Flooded underpass
flooded-underpass.blurb: The dip under the railway is filling with water: take the slip road.

crest-jumps.name: Crest jumps
crest-jumps.blurb: A steep climb and drop: a fast car leaves the ground.

radiated-areas.name: Radiated areas
radiated-areas.blurb: A green haze: your health ticks down and the radiation meter fills.

infected-cars.name: Infected cars
infected-cars.blurb: A glowing car with a ring on the road: within it you are dosed.
